title: Localization & Globalization
description: Implement localization and globalization in ASP.NET Core applications.
longDescription: This module covers how to localize and globalize ASP.NET Core applications to support multiple languages and cultures. You will learn about resource files, Portable Object (PO) files, and how to configure the request localization middleware.
whatYouLearn: Use resource files for string translations
Localize validation messages and data annotations
